'''Joe Horbey Horbey Base''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Joe Horbey]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls134.htm Horbey Base], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027134802/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls134.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
